FN-UAVCGDD-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 118
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/11/2025
Senate Bill 118 as introduced proposes a constitutional amendment, which if ratified, would
expand the list of offenses in which bail may be denied.
Additionally, this bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the
State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026.
